arxiv-2211-09085.creator: Ross Taylor, Marcin Kardas, Guillem Cucurull, Thomas Scialom, Anthony Hartshorn, Elvis Saravia, Andrew Poulton, Viktor Kerkez, Robert Stojnic

The explosive growth in scientific literature and data has made it ever harder to discover useful insights in a large mass of information. Today scientific knowledge is accessed through search engines, but they are unable to organize scientific knowledge alone.

arxiv-2310-18546.title: Einstein-de Haas torque as a discrete spectroscopic probe allows nanomechanical measurement of a magnetic resonance
arxiv-2310-18546.creator: K.R. Fast 1 , 3 , ∗ {}^{1,3,^{\ast}} , J.E. Losby 2 , 3 , ∗ {}^{2,3,^{\ast}} , G. Hajisalem 2,3 , P.E. Barclay 2,3 , M.R. Freeman 1,3
arxiv-2310-18546.description: Abstract The Einstein-de Haas (EdH) effect is a fundamental, mechanical consequence of any temporal change of magnetism in an object. EdH torque results from conserving the object’s total angular momentum: the angular momenta of all the specimen’s magnetic moments, together with its mechanical angular momentum.

arxiv-2401-06302.title: Mixed-permutation channel with its application to estimate quantum coherence
arxiv-2401-06302.creator: Lin Zhang and, Ming-Jing Zhao
arxiv-2401-06302.description: Abstract Quantum channel, as the information transmitter, is an indispensable tool in quantum information theory. In this paper, we study a class of special quantum channels named the mixed-permutation channels . The properties of these channels are characterized. The mixed-permutation channels can be applied to give a lower bound of quantum coherence with respect to any coherence measure.

arxiv-2405-04890.title: GISR: Geometric Initialization and Silhouette-based Refinement for Single-View Robot Pose and Configuration Estimation
arxiv-2405-04890.creator: Ivan Bilić, Filip Marić, Fabio Bonsignorio, Ivan Petrović
arxiv-2405-04890.description: Abstract In autonomous robotics, measurement of the robot’s internal state and perception of its environment, including interaction with other agents such as collaborative robots, are essential. Estimating the pose of the robot arm from a single view has the potential to replace classical eye-to-hand calibration approaches and is particularly attractive for online estimation and dynamic environments.

arxiv-2411-16124.title: Collaboration in Virtual Reality: Survey and Perspectives Thanks: Citation : Authors. Title. Pages…. DOI:000000/11111.
arxiv-2411-16124.creator: Ourania Koutzampasopoulou Xanthidou, Nadine Aburumman, Hanêne Ben-Abdallah
arxiv-2411-16124.description: Abstract The application of Virtual Reality Environments (VRE) has been gaining momentum as a relatively new tool to assist with mitigating various difficulties including abstractness of concepts, lack of user engagement, perception of disconnection from other users. A VRE may offer both synchronous and asynchronous experiences, in addition to an immersive environment which promotes users’ engagement.

arxiv-2412-12219.title: Are Large Language Models Useful for Time Series Data Analysis?
arxiv-2412-12219.creator: Francis Tang, Ying Ding
arxiv-2412-12219.description: Abstract Time series data plays a critical role across diverse domains such as healthcare, energy, and finance, where tasks like classification, anomaly detection, and forecasting are essential for informed decision-making. Recently, large language models (LLMs) have gained prominence for their ability to handle complex data and extract meaningful insights.

arxiv-2503-04048.title: The steady state of gravity-capillary problem with inclined walls
arxiv-2503-04048.creator: Xiaoding Yang
arxiv-2503-04048.description: Abstract . The gravity-capillary problem with inclined walls is a problem that describes an open fluid flowing over an angled wall. It has broad applications in science and engineering. In this paper, we study the steady states of the two-dimensional inclined-wall problem.

pmc-12697086.description: Only 8.6% of the global economy follows the principles of the circular economy.
